description: Grenzen- Veiligheidsregio's in Gelderland is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. A safety region in the Netherlands is an area in which various administrations and services cooperate with regard to tasks in the fields of fire service, disaster management, crisis management, medical assistance in Accidents and Disaster (GHOR) and maintenance of public order and security. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Borders- Safety regions in Gelderland" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
